name: Raw - Organic 6 Pack Cones
description: RAW Organic Hemp Cones are unquestionably the world’s most rawesome organic hemp cones! RAW Organic Hemp Paper is a light tan in color and hand rolled into the perfect cone shape. The tip is hand folded into a W to prevent materials from passing through.
